metadata.description: Linked-intent development workflow and arrow-of-intent tracking

plugins.name: linked-intent-dev
plugins.description: Structured design-before-code workflow: HLD → LLD → EARS specs → Tests → Code. Includes /linked-intent-dev (workflow + bootstrap), /update-lid (configuration reconcile), and /lid-coach (principle-level review).

plugins.name: arrow-maintenance
plugins.description: Scaling layer for linked-intent-dev. Tracks spec-to-code coherence across large projects via docs/arrows/ index. Includes brownfield bootstrap for mapping existing codebases.

plugins.name: lid-experimental
plugins.description: Experimental LID skills with opt-in installation and explicit promotion/retirement lifecycle. Current experiment: bidirectional-differential — audits EARS↔code coherence via parallel fresh-context LLM reconstructions. Layers on top of linked-intent-dev and arrow-maintenance; requires both.
